Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In step 10, the WebSurfer agent retrieved a text snippet from the Treccani/Enciclopedia Italiana entry stating that Lorenzo Costa il Giovane died in 1585. However, this information is factually incorrect and contradicts the overwhelming consensus from multiple other authoritative sources (Wikipedia, Italian Wikipedia, RKD, and general art historical records) which consistently list his death year as 1583. The agent failed to cross-reference this specific claim with the other sources it had already found (which showed 1583) and incorrectly accepted the 1585 date as the definitive answer, leading to the wrong final solution.
